messages:
sarah: Heads up — Nimbus Labs can't find their API key after completing the OIDC flow. Console shows 'Provisioning complete' but API Keys tab is empty. They need access tomorrow. customer id: nimbus-349, tenant: t-abc123. trace id they gave: trace_20250305_07
aj: Got it. Any repro steps/screenshots from them? Which project did the consent flow create or land in?
sarah: They landed in project 'nimbus-prod' (proj-482). Console shows provisioning succeeded, onboarding email references proj-482 and dev@nimbus.com. I asked for screenshots; they sent the console banner and the trace id.
provision-bot: provisioning event: tenant=t-abc123 -> attempted claim bind -> result: claim_assigned_to=proj-482; key_create_attempted -> key_id=key-zzzz (secret masked); post-bind check: key_bound_to=proj-091 (legacy-test); status=orphaned (claim_owner_mismatch).
# log snippet from provision-bot:
```
2025-03-05T07:10:11Z provision-worker INFO claim_bind: tenant=t-abc123 new_owner=proj-482
2025-03-05T07:10:11Z provision-worker WARN claim_bind_conflict: existing_owner=proj-091
2025-03-05T07:10:11Z key-service INFO create_key: key_id=key-zzzz created_for_project=proj-091
2025-03-05T07:10:12Z provision-worker INFO reconcile_attempt queued
```
tom: I can see the same in infra logs. Looks like a claim race: the kv entry still pointed to the old sandbox project (proj-091) while the bind happened. The key was created against whatever project the key-service saw at bind time.
emma: How did proj-091 get involved? That was a legacy sandbox we thought had been cleaned up months ago.
tom: Cleanup didn't fully remove the claim mapping (replication / eventual-consistency window). The bind and cleanup overlapped; result is key creation against stale owner.
aj: What's an immediate customer-facing fix?
tom: Short-term: transfer the tenant claim to the correct project and rebind the key, or generate a new key and rotate. Commands (admin-only):
```
redwood-admin claim transfer --tenant t-abc123 --from proj-091 --to proj-482
redwood-admin key rebind --key key-zzzz --project proj-482
# if rebind not possible: redwood-admin key create --project proj-482 --note "onboard rotation for nimbus-349"
```
If we create a new secret we should revoke the old key. I'll take this. CC @emma for audit.
sarah: Can you run those now? Customer is waiting. CC: @emma for audit trail.
tom: Running transfer now. Will paste audit id.
provision-bot: audit: claim-transfer started by tom at 2025-03-05T07:12:05Z id=audit-a1b2
tom: Transfer completed (audit-a1b2). Attempting key rebind... hit a transient lock: 'index-lock: cannot modify key binding; job locked' — retrying.
tom: Retry succeeded. key-zzzz now bound to proj-482. I also generated a new secret and rotated it to them (rotated key id key-zzzz -> secret rotated). Sent new secret to the customer via secure support channel. Note: rotating will invalidate any running jobs using the old secret.
aj: I told the customer we'll rotate and that they should update their integration ASAP. Sarah, please confirm they tested a call.
sarah: Customer tested a simple generate call, got 200 and tokens returned. They confirmed. :thumbsup:
aj: Permanent fix?
tom: Action items: add stronger CAS when writing claim ownership, ensure cleanup job unbinds before deletions, and add a reconciliation job that flags keys whose bound project != claim owner. I'll open an infra ticket and attach audit + logs.
tom: Creating ticket ENGINFRA-4723 - "claim bind race causing orphaned keys on OIDC onboarding". Linked audit-a1b2 and tenant t-abc123. Assigning to @emma.
emma: I'll take it. Immediate mitigation: add a short backoff in claim-binding worker, emit metric claim_bind_conflicts, and add an alert if orphaned_key_count > 0. Also will add a nightly reconciliation to un-orphan keys or mark them for manual review.
sarah: Customer confirmed new secret works end-to-end and they're unblocked for their go-live. Closing this support thread; will follow up when ENGINFRA-4723 has a patch. Thanks everyone.
